translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
qasam hai sooraj ki aur uss ki pheli howi dhoop ki ,
aur chaand ki jab woh sooraj kay peechay peechay aaye ,
aur din ki jab woh sooraj ka jalwa dikha dey ,
aur raat ki jab woh uss per chah ker ussay chupa ley ,
aur qasam hai aasman ki , aur uss ki jiss ney ussay banaya ,
aur zameen ki , aur uss ki jiss ney ussay bichaya ,
aur insani jaan ki , aur uss ki jiss ney ussay sanwara ,
phir uss kay dil mein woh baat bhi daal di jo uss kay liye bad-kaari ki hai , aur woh bhi jo uss kay liye perhezgari ki hai ,
falah ussay milay gi jo iss nafs ko pakeezah banaye ,
aur na-murad woh hoga jo uss ko ( gunah mein ) dhansa dey .
qoam-e-samood ney apni sarkashi say ( payghumber ko ) jhutlaya ,
jab unn ka sabb say sangdil shaks uth kharra huwa ,
to Allah kay payghumber ney unn say kaha kay :  khabrdar ! Allah ki oontni ka aur uss kay paani peenay ka poora khayal rakhna .
phir bhi unhon ney payghumber ko jhutlaya , aur uss oontni ko maar daala .   nateeja yeh kay unn kay perwerdigar ney unn kay gunah ki wajeh say unn ki eent say eent baja ker sabb ko barabar kerdiya .
aur Allah ko uss kay kissi buray anjam ka koi khof nahi hai .
